notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.content:
[h3][u]Added[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]- Color blindness support with distinguishable particle effects for the Sight ability
[*]- App focus awareness for pausing when the headset is removed or the SteamVR dash is opened
[/list]

[h3][u]Changed[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]- Pasture assets
[/list]

[h3][u]Fixed[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*]- Bug where snap turn would perform both a 45 and 180 degree turn on a single flick
[*]- Various tutorial bug fixes and UI visual adjustments
[/list]

tags.feature: - Color blindness support with distinguishable particle effects for the Sight ability
- App focus awareness for pausing when the headset is removed or the SteamVR dash is opened

tags.bug: - Bug where snap turn would perform both a 45 and 180 degree turn on a single flick
- Various tutorial bug fixes and UI visual adjustments
